note: Medicine Bow NF campground in open ponderosa pine and rock on a ridge north of Laramie Peak, 3 miles east of Esterbrook on Forest Road 633. The FS recommends coming the Ridge Road from Glendo, not up the switchbacks from Horseshoe Creek Road; FR 633 can be muddy and slick in snowmelt or after heavy rain. Trails to Sunset Ridge leave the campground; OHV trailhead parking is half a mile west, and OHVs may not be driven in the campground. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov facility, rates and catalog read: 12 sites (group 001, tent-only 005, the rest RV/trailer, max vehicle 51 ft), 9 reservable / 3 FCFS, 14-night max, $20 single ($40 double, $65 group), vault toilets + water, no hookups, mid-May to early Nov (2027 May 20-Nov 1). All groups written. Not waterfront holds. Pin fine (~100 m from centroid). Phone empty -> 307-358-4690. Note cleaned.
flags: ACCESS: rec.gov notice 'We recommend coming the Ridge Rd from Glendo and NOT up the switchbacks from Horseshoe Creek Rd.' and 'could still become muddy and slick during snow melt or after a significant rain event'; directions say 'easily accessible to automobiles of all types'.
